description: exp10 with the anchor-pair actor's sum-over-tables readout replaced by a SUM-SCALED (mean-normalised) temperature-tau log-sum-exp: out = T * tau * log((1/T) * sum_t exp(w_t/tau)). This generalises the SUM rather than the mean: tau->inf recovers exp10's sum_t w_t exactly, tau->0 gives T*max(w). tau is the only new trainable parameter (softplus, > 0). Everything else identical to exp10.
readout: T * tau * log((1/T) * sum_tables exp(w / tau))
weight_init: plain additive U(+-initial_weights_noise) — no special init
init_note: at init the readout matches exp10's plain sum to 5.4% of the output std (residual = the Jensen gap, predicted 1.07e-4, measured 1.79e-4); gradient sums to 32 over tables, matching exp10, against 1 for the plain log-sum-exp
abandoned_attempts: plain log-sum-exp (exp_outputs_scale='mean') with additive init (final 495) and with log-space init (plateaued ~350, stopped at update 430) — both kept under attempt*/
